scope: one accepted real-data Zhou Yu chapter
method: Each source quote was checked against the pinned source pack; the listed candidate record, phase, event or translation block was then checked in the accepted candidate and public chapter response. pass_with_uncertainty means the source-attributed qualification was deliberately retained.

source_quotes: 周瑜字公瑾
checks.assertion: The courtesy-name claim resolves to literal 公瑾 and is present in the first translated block.

source_quotes: 廬江舒人也
checks.assertion: Native place remains linked to 周瑜 through 廬江/舒 and the public block carries the source anchor set.

source_quotes: 從祖父景，景子忠，皆為漢太尉
父異，洛陽令
checks.assertion: The first block preserves 周景、周忠、周異 as separate source-owned entities and renders their stated offices.

observed.translation_contains: 周景、周忠、汉朝太尉、周异、洛阳县令

source_quotes: 策親自迎瑜，授建威中郎將，即與兵二千人，騎五十匹
checks.assertion: The early appointment and later offices stay attached to 周瑜 rather than being flattened into an undated person label.

observed.translation_contains: 建威中郎将、春谷县长、中护军、江夏太守

checks.topic: 孙策去世后的连续身份
source_quotes: 五年，策薨。權統事。瑜將兵赴喪，遂留吳，以中護軍與長史張昭共掌眾事
checks.assertion: Succession, the mourning visit and the continuing 中護軍 office are represented as a connected phase with 張昭.

observed.translation_contains: 建安五年、孙权接掌、共同掌管军政事务

source_quotes: 十一年，督孫瑜等討麻、保二屯
十三年春，權討江夏，瑜為前部大督
其年九月，曹公入荊州，劉琮舉眾降
checks.assertion: The accepted events retain 206, 208 spring/range and 208 September/month precision; the public time-group pages expose the continuation.

source_quotes: 瑜請得精兵三萬人，進住夏口，保為將軍破之
臣松之以為建計拒曹公，實始魯肅
checks.assertion: The main narrative assigns the proposal to 周瑜 while the Pei Songzhi attribution difference remains an explicit source-qualified claim.

observed.main_claim: 拒绝迎降曹操并出兵抗击

source_quotes: 時曹公軍眾已有疾病
然觀操軍船艦，首尾相接，可燒而走也
赤壁之役，值有疾病，孤燒船自退，橫使周瑜虛獲此名
checks.assertion: The accepted bundle retains the illness/fire account and the contrary Cao Cao account as separate source-attributed records.

observed.fire_claim: 以火攻焚烧曹军相连船舰

source_quotes: 會流矢中右脅，瘡甚，便還
權拜瑜偏將軍，領南郡太守
checks.assertion: The wound and recovery narrative precedes the later appointment as 偏将军/南郡太守, with both events linked to source blocks.

observed.translation_contains: 被流箭射中右胁、偏将军、南郡太守

source_quotes: 權以曹公在北方，當廣攬英雄，又恐備難卒制，故不納
checks.assertion: The proposal to control 刘备 and 孙权's explicit rejection remain distinct event/claim records rather than an asserted outcome.

observed.decision_value: 孙权不采纳周瑜控制刘备的建议

source_quotes: 權許之。瑜還江陵為行裝，而道於巴丘病卒
臣松之案，瑜欲取蜀，還江陵治嚴，所卒之處，應在今之巴陵，與前所鎮巴丘，名同處異也
checks.assertion: The plan approval and death are separate events; the annotation's same-name/different-place warning is retained as source uncertainty.

observed.approval_claim: 孙权批准周瑜取蜀计划

source_quotes: 男循尚公主，拜騎都尉
循弟胤，初拜興業都尉
權乃許之。會胤病死
瑜兄子峻，亦以瑜元功為偏將軍
checks.assertion: The descendant office, petition/death sequence and 周峻/周護 late-stage sequence are preserved with separate event refs and source blocks.

observed.translation_contains: 骑都尉、兴业都尉、周胤病死、偏将军、停止任用
